summary: Ancient's Yuzo Koshiro-associated action-RPG line, pairing the Genesis/Mega Drive game Beyond Oasis with the Sega Saturn prequel The Legend of Oasis.

entries.title: Beyond Oasis

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Use Switch Online for current official access; Genesis Plus GX is appropriate for owned-dump archival capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with emulator conveniences.

primary.why: The Switch Online Genesis release is the current official route for the original game with save/rewind convenience; older Steam, mobile, Virtual Console, compilation, and mini-console paths do not add exclusive playable content.
primary.how_to_play: Play through the SEGA Genesis app with Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack. Use an owned Steam/Sega Classics copy or Genesis Plus GX only as a capture/archive fallback.

all_releases.fidelity: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release with modern emulator conveniences and Switch 2 compatibility marked supported on Nintendo's store page.
all_releases.reason: primary: current official access path with no sourced content loss.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The known re-releases are emulated routes for the same Genesis game; no sourced exclusive-content conflict.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern releases emulate the Genesis game rather than remaster it; the mobile release has been delisted.

entries.title: The Legend of Oasis

emulation.emulator: Mednafen/Beetle Saturn or MiSTer Saturn core
emulation.notes: Saturn emulation is the practical high-fidelity route when original hardware is not available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Saturn presentation with emulator scaling and capture conveniences.

primary.why: The Legend of Oasis is a Sega Saturn prequel/successor with no sourced modern port or remaster, so the original Saturn version is the complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Saturn hardware, MiSTer Saturn core, or a high-accuracy Saturn emulator such as Mednafen/Beetle Saturn using an owned disc image.

all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release and therefore the complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate release or exclusive-content split.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster or re-release.
